authoring.name: Collection Bag
authoring.description: Cream cloth collection bag with mint reinforced open mouth and coral ribbon handles.
notes: Reference: collection-bag-v1.png. S=.28 miniature metre scale.
Continuous outer wall, inner wall, mouth bridge, separate floor surfaces and real ribbon handle thickness.
half_full/full/sealed are mutually exclusive complete shape states; do not add them together.
The sealed shape includes gathered cuff, relocated loop handles and sliding orange clasp. Runtime pour can rotate asset_root around pour_origin.
Contents are intentionally omitted; half/full states communicate capacity with the silhouette and preserve the true cavity.
